title: APeB: Benchmarking Personalization Ability of Large Language Model Agents
abstract: arXiv:2607.03162v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: LLM-powered agents struggle with personalization when users issue raw, underspecified queries. In this setting, agents must infer latent intent, extract preferences from noisy interaction histories, and select among competing alternatives. Existing benchmarks rarely test this capability, as they often rely on user-refined queries or simplified histories. We introduce personalized product search (PPS), a testbed for agentic personalization under raw queries and diverse histories. We construct Agent Personalized Benchmark (APeB) from action logs, pairing underspecified intents with rich histories and user-viewed candidate items. Evaluating state-of-the-art LLMs with multi-step agent workflows, we find that models handle explicit queries well but struggle with early-stage queries requiring intent and preference discovery. Rubric analysis attributes this gap mainly to ineffective history use. A simple history-aware query-refinement pipel

translated_title: APeB：大语言模型智能体个性化能力基准测试
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体在用户发出原始的、欠规范的查询时难以实现个性化。在这种场景下，智能体必须推断潜在意图、从嘈杂的交互历史中提取用户偏好，并在相互竞争的候选项中进行选择。现有基准很少测试这种能力，因为它们通常依赖于用户精炼后的查询或简化的历史记录。我们提出了个性化产品搜索（PPS）这一任务，作为在原始查询和多样化历史条件下测试智能体个性化能力的试验平台。我们从用户行为日志中构建了智能体个性化基准（APeB），将欠规范的意图与丰富的交互历史以及用户浏览过的候选商品相配对。通过多步骤智能体工作流评估最先进的大语言模型，我们发现模型能够很好地处理显式查询，但在需要意图发现和偏好挖掘的早期查询上表现不佳。基于评分标准的分析将这一差距主要归因于对历史记录的低效利用。一个简单的基于历史信息的查询精炼流水线……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出个性化产品搜索任务和APeB基准，用于评估大语言模型智能体在原始欠规范查询与丰富交互历史下的个性化能力，发现现有模型在早期模糊查询的意图与偏好发现上表现不佳，其主要原因是对历史信息利用不足。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces personalized product search (PPS) and the APeB benchmark to evaluate the personalization ability of LLM agents under raw, underspecified queries and rich interaction histories, finding that current models struggle with early-stage intent and preference discovery, mainly due to ineffective use of interaction history.
